correlation.note: lvkit structural node changes align with LabVIEW NON-cosmetic differences; LabVIEW additionally reports cosmetic (position/appearance) diffs lvkit omits by design

preview.source: rendered from the comparison report STAGED locations (per report HTML: First VI=left-<base>, Second VI=right-<selected>)

pipeline.principle: the VI Comparison report is the SINGLE parameter source: its HTML embeds base+head commits AND the on-disk staged paths (left-<base>-*.vi, right-<selected>-*.vi in a full staged tree). Those staged paths feed BOTH the VI Preview render (base + selected) AND lvkit diff/generate -- no separate git checkout.
